sections.label: Walk Cycle Ride aspiration
sections.summary: Singapore aims for 75% of peak hour trips on public transport by 2030, with mode share rising from 64% in 2013 to 67% last year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Our Walk Cycle Ride aspiration is for Singaporeans to choose to walk, cycle and ride public transport, instead of driving.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We have set a target of 75% of peak hour trips to be on public transport by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The mode share of public transport has risen from 64% in 2013 to 67% last year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We expect it to rise further as more rail lines are launched.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The increasing use of personal mobility devices as a first- and last-mile mode of travel has also contributed towards this vision.
